Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Repo indkhan/Moneo. GitHub issue #243 stage 3 (read `gh issue view 243`, AGENTS.md, and the bodies of merged PRs #299 (stage 1, lib/bank) and #303 (stage 2, lib/finance source files)). `tsconfig.indexed.json` includes `lib/finance/**/*.ts` but excludes `lib/finance/**/*.test.ts`; the `@typescript-eslint/no-non-null-assertion` lint rule honours the same exclude. `scripts/typecheck-indexed.mjs` (run by `npm run typecheck`) reports only errors in covered files. Tests use `defined()` from `lib/testing.ts` for values that must be present.

This stage: delete that exclude entry so the 243 errors in lib/finance test files are checked, and fix them all, plus every `!` in those tests the lint rule then flags. Rules: never add `!`; use `defined(value, "what")` or a destructuring/guard; keep each test's assertions and meaning unchanged (a test must still fail when the behaviour breaks); no formatter; mechanical changes only. If a test turns out to assert something wrong, stop and say so in the PR body rather than changing what it checks. If it's far more than one reviewable PR, split by file groups and say what remains.

Create branch `t3/issue-243-finance-tests-indexed` from origin/main. Commit in steps with plain messages ending with "Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>". Update the AGENTS.md row if it mentions the exclude. Before opening the PR, merge origin/main again. Run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` yourself and quote their last lines. Tests use only the moneo-qa test backend; never the owner's backend (.env, Docker project `moneo`, port 3000). Never run `qa:reset` or `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`. Never kill a process you didn't start (verify by PID). Don't end your turn while a command is still running. No comments in code. Open the PR (body ends with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)"), never merge it. Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>.
